question: After how many years did India win the gold medal in the men's hockey tournament in the Asian Games in 2014?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**16 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the **2014 Asian Games**, India won the **gold medal** in the men’s hockey tournament after a gap of **16 years**. Their previous gold medal victory was in the year **1998**.
 
• The final match in 2014 was played against **Pakistan**, which India won in a dramatic penalty shootout with a score of **4-2**.
 
• This victory marked a significant achievement for India as it ended a long wait for gold in the **Asian Games hockey tournament**.
 
• The win also secured India a direct qualification for the **2016 Rio Olympics**, adding to its importance.
 
• Indian men’s hockey has a rich history, being one of the most successful teams in the world, with victories in multiple **Olympic Games** and **Asian Games**.
 
• The team's resurgence in 2014 underlined their commitment to regaining their dominance in the sport.
 
• India’s victory in the 2014 Asian Games was part of a broader effort to revive its traditional strength in hockey, which included improved **training facilities**, better coaching, and an emphasis on **fitness and strategy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Key Points Related to Indian Hockey**__

 
 
• The Indian men’s hockey team has historically been one of the most successful teams in the world, with a record of **8 Olympic gold medals**.
 
• The **Asian Games** hockey tournament was introduced in **1958**, and India has been a dominant force in this competition as well.
 
• India’s win in the **2014 Asian Games** was its **third gold medal** in the history of the competition, the previous ones being in **1966** and **1998**.
 
• The victory against Pakistan in 2014 was especially significant, as the two nations share a fierce rivalry in hockey.
 
• The **Asian Hockey Federation** oversees hockey competitions in Asia, including the Asian Games hockey tournaments.
 
• India's success in recent years in international hockey tournaments has been supported by organizations like **Hockey India**, which governs the sport in the country.
